current_whole_chain.current_behavior: A request is emitted only when accepted non-simulation mode, rule version, intake domain_pack_ref, and an independently supplied semantic_facet_denominator_receipt_ref are present. The current bridge supplies no denominator, mode basis, pack or facet material. Pack admission is reached only after request/ref plus mode-basis/pack dependencies exist. Existing admission distinguishes missing pack from binding mismatch once called, but no selected-ref load result represents present malformed/unresolved material.

The bridge again passes None for pack/basis/facet material into replay. Existing replay material is process-local and is not an owner-bound selected-profile loader; a fresh reader cannot infer owner ABI from a ref.

GET /api/v1/control/jobs/{job_id} exposes durable job status/progress; it has no domain-pack admission view. Generic artifact routes can select a profile but are not wired as an EvalSafety pack consumer.

decision_impacts.if_option_A: Adds a versioned source-owned ABI, owner-defined writer/member/profile path, and typed distinction for present-invalid refs; requires migration policy for old refs. External authority remains blocked until separately supplied.
decision_impacts.if_option_B: No protected admission claim. Generic reader supports candidate inspection with explicit not_established limitation; the consumer must never label it admitted.
decision_impacts.if_option_C: No identity-semantic migration or writer, but bridge_missing and no distinct present-refusal semantics remain.
decision_impacts.time_and_status: No clock shift, broad waiver, issuer substitution, or automatic expiry. Owner schema version/validity semantics require owner-supplied policy; currentness remains not_established absent current evidence.

source-defined writer/encoder and selected-profile-bound reference shape
compatibility and migration behavior for existing profileless refs and prior schema versions

option_A_recommended.name: owner_registered_versioned_producer_contract
option_A_recommended.owner_assignment_required: G must name the actual defining producer and accept its ABI/versioning/migration responsibility. The caller-supplied pack_component_id is not nominated as owner.
semantics: A named producer contract fixes exact Core manifest kind and media type, a finite accepted schema-name/version set, and the mapping from each accepted manifest schema to DomainEvalSafetyPack.schema_version.

That producer writes a real content-addressed DomainEvalSafetyPack member through the existing CAS write contract and returns a typed PDC ArtifactRef binding the content identity and exact selected manifest-profile SHA-256.

The trusted owner contract, not the selected artifact, constructs CoreArtifactOwnerProfile. The worker selects and validates that exact profile, validates the payload, and checks the PDC pack semantic hash against payload content_hash.

Outcomes distinguish true absence, selected owner-conformant material, present but unresolvable/malformed input, and wrong kind/media/schema/payload version. A supplied malformed ref never becomes absence or domain_pack_missing.
The same selected profile identity is retained through immutable request, persisted decision/replay and a fresh consumer; it is not only an in-memory loaded object.
Profile conformance establishes material identity only. Mode basis, semantic denominator, verifier appointment, issuer/currentness, evidence, permission and commit-time checks remain independent.

option_B.impact: No new owner identity contract or writer. The domain-pack bridge remains incomplete; any candidate consumer that inspects a supplied ref still needs a typed invalid-present outcome.
option_B.name: candidate_only_explicit_limitation
option_B.semantics: Generic Core reads may inspect candidate material only. With no defining owner ABI, status remains not_established; no protected admission, certificate, or external authority follows. Preserve the blocked field_pilot result and expose the limitation.

option_C.impact: No new identity/migration semantics, but current bridge_missing state and no distinct present-refusal semantics remain. This is not implemented capability.
option_C.name: leave_bridge_missing_until_owner_is_named
option_C.semantics: Do not decode a supplied ref as DomainEvalSafetyPack; preserve current fail-closed blocking until an actual producer owner is appointed.

decision_requested_from_G.question: May DomainEvalSafetyPack become an owner-bound Core artifact, and which named producer owns its finite wire ABI? Do not infer the owner from the caller reference, selected manifest, pack_component_id, fixture, or adjacent B164 authority requirement.
decision_requested_from_G.recommendation: Choose owner_registered_versioned_producer_contract only after naming its defining source owner. Reuse CoreArtifactOwnerProfile and existing Core CAS/profile APIs. If no source owner can be assigned, choose explicit candidate_only_limitation and keep protected field_pilot blocked; do not create a PolicyOS-owned producer by default.
